}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|MediaTek reference design}}
===Feature=== *CPU: Embedded MIPS 24KEc (580MHz) :with 64KB I-cache and 32 KB D-cache :DDR1/2 16-bit (128/256Mb) (MT7628AN/KN) :MCM 8Mb (DDR1) KGD ([[MediaTek]] MT7628KN) *2T2R 2.4GHz with 300Mbps PHY data rate :IPEX connector: x1 (PIFA optional) *WLAN Legacy 802.11b/g and HT 802.11n modes :20/40 MHz channel bandwidth, 16 Multiple BSSID *Reverse Data Grant (RDG) *Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC) *Space Time Block Coding (STBC) *Internet Of Thing, An optimized PMU, Green AP :- Intelligent Clock Scaling (exclusive) :- DDR II: ODT off, Self-refresh mode *WEP64/128, TKIP, AES, WPA, WPA2, WAPI *QoS: WMM, WMM-PS, WPS: PBC, PIN *Voice Enterprise: 802.11k+r *AP Firmware: OpenWrt, Linux 2.6 SDK, eCOS with IPv6 *USB (Type-C) power connector
